author: Frank Jacobson Jr.
text:
Gluroo is a great app or glucowatch. Both are free no subscription or fees

Both use Libre link to connect. 

Glucowatch will do simple Apple Watch displaying. This option is very good and reliable . 

Gluroo does alot more like

1 place reading number on widget also as a direct on notification so in your sleep screen. 

2 place reading in CarPlay screen in your car. 

Also good food tracker and lots of ways to read stats.
